_about: Crumb Defense tuning - the SOURCE OF TRUTH for the numbers below. Edit, then rebuild (see README.md in this folder). Not loaded at runtime; the build bundles it.

_units.rangeTiles: radius from the tower centre in map tiles (1 tile = 40 px)
_units.cardUpgrades: steps to card levels L2..L10, in order. power / rate / any other key: fraction (+0.10 = +10%); range: tiles (+0.2 tiles)
_units.battleUpgrades: in-battle levels 2-6 (five upgrades; drop the same card on the tower): multipliers
_units.queenTake: a queen takes 50 + the sum of her trait modifiers (queenTraitMods) from the treat
_units.heal: optional ant field (v0.7.8 nurse): { radius (tiles), pct (of the TARGET's max hp per pulse), every (s, cooldown after a pulse), bossMul (multiplier when the target is a queen) }. A ready, unfrozen healer pulses when >= 1 hurt non-healer ant is in range; she never heals herself or another healer.
_units.rarity: common | uncommon | rare | elite | boss (v0.7.7). Checked by tests/v077.test.js for worlds >= 3: >= 2 common types per non-boss level, <= 2 rare-or-higher types, a rare first appears at wave >= 2 (never wave 1). W1/W2 only report.

shop._about: v0.6.2 items 12/13. unlockPrice: coins to unlock a locked tower in the Shop (tiered by base power, approved by Yair). packNewTowerChance: chance that a card pack holds ONE new (locked) tower card (L1) as one of its cards.

economy._about: v0.7.6 E1/E2/E3/E5. starBonus: coins paid ONCE per level the first time it reaches 2 (key 2) and 3 (key 3) stars (a 1 -> 3 star jump pays both; stored stars count as already paid, no retroactive grant). bossGems: diamonds on the FIRST clear of a world's last level (its queen) and on the first 3 stars there. calendar.coinsByStreak: coins of the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th+ coin prize of a streak, multiplied by 1 + worldStep x (highest unlocked world - 1), rounded to a multiple of roundTo. worlds[].coinMul (default 1) multiplies the win coins of that world's levels (not the first-clear bonus, not loss coins).
